approved_plate_validation.method: existing validator run on disposable exact copy; original source and approval evidence untouched

artifact_preservation.scope: all masters, retained PNGs, every original plate file, AGENTS and normative shared guides

committed_checkout.method: fresh git clone --no-hardlinks --local; local git lfs fetch origin HEAD; git lfs checkout; git lfs fsck; both existing Blender validators rerun from checkout
committed_checkout.final_receipt_update_scope: QA/status metadata and documentation only; no native/render/script changes after fresh-checkout validation
